english.title: Ship's master / aircraft commander fail to explain breakage / destruction / alteration of goods
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), were the

(A)_[master of a ship,]_
(B)_[commander of an aircraft,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE SHIP / AIRCRAFT..), carrying goods brought therein from a place outside the United Kingdom, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PLACE..), and arriving

(C)_[in]_
(D)_[over]_

United Kingdom waters when, before a report had been made in accordance with section 35 of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979,

(E)_[the bulk was broken]_
(F)_[an alteration was made in the stowage of goods so as to facilitate the unloading of part thereof before due report had been made]_
(G)_[a part of the goods was staved, destroyed or thrown overboard]_
(H)_[a container was opened]_

and the matter was not explained to the satisfaction of the Commissioners
english.legislation: Contrary to section 35(7) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
